title: Diffuse beam spot after quad_2 drift
text: Beam spot became diffuse after quad_2 drift during warm injector shift. Increasing quad_2 worsened halo. Operators restored quad_2 baseline and checked RF phase readback. Beam recovered after RF correction
recommended_action: Do not increase quad_2 until RF phase readback is verified. Take a calibration screen if uncertainty remains high

title: RF phase drift readback mismatch
text: Virtual diagnostic predicted stable beam but RF phase readback lagged the commanded phase after cavity warmup. Small phase correction recovered current
recommended_action: Verify RF phase readback and make small correcting steps only after checking the cavity monitor

title: High charge halo during injector tune
text: High charge setting produced a visible halo ring on the OTR screen. Quad scans made the halo worse until charge was lowered
recommended_action: Reduce charge proxy or request screen calibration before aggressive focusing

title: Injector warmup drift moved quad optimum
text: During warmup the best quad_1 and quad_2 settings shifted slowly over twenty minutes. Old model predictions were optimistic
recommended_action: Request a calibration screen after warmup drift before applying optimizer suggestions

title: Model uncertainty after maintenance
text: After vacuum maintenance the injector response changed. The model underpredicted beam size until a fresh calibration screen was taken
recommended_action: Block autonomous writes until calibration data is added

title: BPM noise during low current
text: BPM readings jumped while current proxy was low. Operators ignored single BPM spikes and relied on screen confirmation
recommended_action: Request confirmation measurement if BPM noise and diagnostic uncertainty are both elevated

title: Screen calibration issue after camera swap
text: Camera swap changed apparent beam size by about fifteen percent. Virtual diagnostic appeared wrong until screen scaling was updated
recommended_action: Take calibration screen and update screen scale before trusting size estimates

title: Steering magnet saturation warning
text: Steering magnet approached saturation while correcting an off axis beam. Further steer_x increase had little effect and raised loss
recommended_action: Require operator review before larger steering correction

title: Vacuum warning near diagnostic section
text: Vacuum warning appeared near diagnostic section after a lossy tune. Operators backed out quadrupole and RF amplitude changes
recommended_action: Block risky settings until vacuum warning clears

title: Bad calibration readback created false confidence
text: A stale calibration readback made the model look green while screen image was clipped. Operators repeated calibration and flagged the run
recommended_action: Repeat calibration when readback metadata is stale

title: OTR screen insertion issue
text: Screen insertion produced inconsistent intensity and false halo labels. Operators repeated the insertion and compared BPM stability
recommended_action: Do not use single screen image if insertion status is uncertain

title: High beam loss after aggressive quadrupole tuning
text: A large simultaneous quad_1 and quad_2 move improved predicted size but caused measured beam loss. Operators reverted to smaller steps
recommended_action: Clip quadrupole moves and require approval for aggressive focusing

title: Cavity amplitude readback mismatch
text: RF amplitude command and readback diverged after a cavity interlock reset. Beam current fell despite good model prediction
recommended_action: Verify amplitude readback before applying RF amplitude change

title: Hysteresis in magnet current
text: Quad_2 response depended on previous current direction. Returning to the same setpoint did not restore the same beam spot
recommended_action: Use smaller approach-from-below steps and request human review for quad_2 reversal

title: Maintenance changed machine response
text: After injector maintenance the old twin overestimated quality in the same PV region. Calibration restored agreement
recommended_action: Request calibration after maintenance before autonomous writes

title: Night shift recovery from diffuse beam
text: Night shift recovered diffuse beam by checking RF phase before touching quad_2. Increasing quad_2 first made the halo worse
recommended_action: Check RF phase and take a screen before increasing quad_2

title: Operator warning on quad_2 increase
text: Operators noted not to increase quad_2 when halo and RF readback drift appear together. The safer move was RF correction
recommended_action: Require human review for quad_2 increase in halo state

title: BPM cable intermittent noise
text: BPM x readout alternated between two offsets while screen stayed centered. Cable reseat fixed the issue
recommended_action: Do not steer based only on noisy BPM readings

title: Charge monitor drift after source cleaning
text: Charge proxy drifted high after source cleaning and caused halo alerts that did not match screen intensity
recommended_action: Verify charge calibration before reducing beam current

title: RF phase correction recovered current
text: A small RF phase correction improved current after readback drift. Larger phase moves created energy jitter
recommended_action: Apply only small RF phase correction after readback verification

title: Steer_y correction clipped screen
text: A steer_y correction moved the beam toward the screen edge and clipped the image. Operators reduced the step and recentered
recommended_action: Require review for steering move when screen is already near edge

title: Slow thermal drift in RF cavity
text: Rising temperature changed RF phase response over the first hour of operations
recommended_action: Wait for thermal settling or request calibration if uncertainty is elevated

title: Quad_1 scan showed astigmatism
text: Quad_1 scan improved x size but worsened y size causing astigmatic beam
recommended_action: Use coupled quad scan and avoid single large quad_1 correction

title: Screen halo from optical background
text: Camera background created false halo on a low current beam. Background subtraction fixed the label
recommended_action: Repeat screen with background subtraction before blocking on halo alone

title: Loss monitor spike after RF amplitude raise
text: RF amplitude raise improved predicted quality but loss monitor spiked. Readback was slow by several seconds
recommended_action: Require readback stability before RF amplitude increase

title: Corrector trim helped after BPM verification
text: A small steer_x trim recovered centered beam after both BPMs and screen agreed
recommended_action: Approve small steering trim only when diagnostics agree

title: Model stale after optics file update
text: Optics file update changed transfer matrix signs for one quadrupole and the model confidence was misleading
recommended_action: Request model verification and calibration before using optimizer output

title: Low charge made image diffuse
text: Low charge created a noisy diffuse-looking image while BPMs were stable
recommended_action: Check charge and repeat screen before quad correction

title: RF amplitude rollback restored beam
text: Beam loss rose after RF amplitude increase. Rolling back amplitude and checking phase restored beam
recommended_action: Do not chase loss with more RF amplitude

title: Quad_2 hysteresis after polarity change
text: Polarity change on quad_2 left residual hysteresis. Increasing quad_2 worsened halo until cycling procedure was used
recommended_action: Run magnet cycling procedure before further quad_2 increase

title: BPM y offset due electronics
text: BPM y offset was caused by electronics drift. Steering to the false readback clipped the screen
recommended_action: Request human review when BPM noise conflicts with screen centroid

title: Calibration screen revealed larger beam size
text: The twin predicted a compact spot but calibration screen showed larger x size. Smaller steps were approved afterward
recommended_action: Use calibration measurement to reduce local OOD risk before allowing small correction

title: Source warmup caused slow current rise
text: Current rose slowly during source warmup and halo disappeared after stabilization
recommended_action: Wait for warmup stabilization before aggressive focusing

title: Steer_x saturation during recovery
text: Steer_x was near limit and additional correction barely moved BPM x. Operators changed upstream steering instead
recommended_action: Block or review large steer_x increase near saturation

title: RF readback stuck after interlock
text: After interlock RF readback stuck briefly while command changed. Model prediction was invalid during the mismatch
recommended_action: Wait for readback agreement before trusting virtual diagnostic

title: Quad pair mismatch caused emittance growth
text: Large unbalanced quad move improved centroid but increased emittance proxy
recommended_action: Use balanced smaller quad steps and request review for large single-quadrupole moves

title: Clipped screen hid halo
text: Beam was clipped at screen edge and halo estimate was unreliable. Recentered screen showed true diffuse profile
recommended_action: Recentering or calibration required before action based on clipped image

title: Charge spike after laser timing change
text: Laser timing change produced a charge spike and halo. Quad correction did not fix it
recommended_action: Check charge source before quadrupole focusing

title: RF phase small correction approved
text: With low uncertainty and verified readback a small RF phase correction improved beam current
recommended_action: Approve small RF phase correction when model is green and readback is stable

title: Model OOD near high temperature
text: High cavity temperature pushed safe signals outside the model envelope
recommended_action: Request calibration or wait for thermal recovery

title: OTR image showed astigmatic halo
text: Image moments showed astigmatic halo after a quad_2 increase. Operators backed out the move
recommended_action: Require review for quad_2 increase when astigmatic halo is present

title: BPM agreement allowed small trim
text: Both BPMs agreed with centered screen and a small steer_y trim was approved
recommended_action: Allow small trim if trust is green and screen is centered

title: Vacuum recovery required conservative steps
text: After vacuum recovery operators limited quad changes to small approved steps
recommended_action: Require human review for larger optics moves after vacuum event

title: Screen gain issue mimicked low charge
text: Screen gain issue made beam look weak while charge proxy was normal
recommended_action: Calibrate camera gain before changing source settings

title: RF amplitude and phase coupled drift
text: Amplitude and phase drifted together after cavity work. Single-knob correction was unreliable
recommended_action: Take calibration and verify both RF readbacks before optimizer action

title: Quad_1 safe small step
text: Model was green and screen centered. A small quad_1 change improved beam size with no loss
recommended_action: Approve small green-envelope quad_1 changes

title: Diffuse beam from temperature drift
text: Diffuse spot appeared while temperature rose and model uncertainty increased. Calibration showed changed optimum
recommended_action: Request calibration rather than large optics move

title: Steering correction after noisy BPM rejected
text: An optimizer proposed steer_x based on noisy BPM x. Screen did not confirm the offset
recommended_action: Require human review before steering on noisy BPM-only evidence

title: Calibration recovery approved small RF step
text: After calibration screen the local OOD risk dropped and a smaller RF phase correction was approved
recommended_action: Apply clipped RF correction and continue monitoring

title: Halo improved after RF check not quad increase
text: Halo state resembled quad_2 mismatch but RF phase readback was the root cause. Increasing quad_2 first worsened loss
recommended_action: Check RF phase and avoid quad_2 increase until calibration confirms optics
